title: Quantitative Method layer
input_boundary: Verified P1 ProjectedPosition and canonical read model
scope: A replaceable, attributable Graphology-backed Method registry and transparent structural-analysis pack whose outputs are derived, reproducible, time-bounded, and interpretation-guarded.
non_goals: LLM provider calls or natural-language interpretation
PossibilityStore, branch search, replay frontier, or Forecast Assessment
Web workbench, Skill, CLI client, or HTTP API
diffusion simulation, opaque embeddings, GNN prediction, personality scoring, or one universal influence score

criteria.expected: Exact-version Graphology dependencies install from the lockfile and the Method executor is replaceable behind typed registry/executor contracts.
Schema migration ownership persists immutable Method definitions, attributable Method runs, typed raw outputs, caveats, and deterministic output identities as derived data.
A Position is converted to a typed directed graph using only its projected Nodes, Relations, and Flows, with edge provenance and declared weight semantics retained.

The foundation pack computes typed k-hop context, directed degree/strength, components, reachability/shortest paths, density, reciprocity, local clustering, betweenness, and node-category mixing/assortativity with explicit scope and interpretation guards.

Exploratory PageRank exposes direction, damping, weight semantics, convergence configuration, and a non-universal-influence caveat; Louvain exposes an undirected projection plus seed/resolution sensitivity runs and a non-faction caveat.
A Position-to-Position delta reports structural additions/removals and metric changes while distinguishing valid time, evidence cutoff, and profile snapshot inputs.
Method output can carry explicit per-Party vector score structures with objective, horizon, dimensions, units, uncertainty, evidence/Method references, and no hidden scalar winner.
Identical Position identity, Method identity/version, configuration, and graph input reproduce the same run/output identity and raw output; changed configuration produces a different identity.
Method execution and derived-result rebuild cannot mutate canonical tables; failures remain explicit and do not leave a successful partial result.
The synthetic P0/P1 workflow can project a Position, run and persist the selected P2 pack, read attributable results, and pass runtime, compatibility, repository, and public-boundary gates.
